title: 第11章 小胖龙第12章 那叫放屁
lines: 火魅笑着。
笑容怪怪的，看的林铮有些毛骨悚然。
“火魅长老有事不妨直说。”
“还不愿意拜师？”
“我天赋有限，火魅长老不如去看看其他人，我喜欢独自修炼。”
轻哼一声，火魅冷冷问道：“我现在问你，之前你真的是在帮我吞食剧毒？”
火魅伸出手，手心里有着一枚丹药，说道：“测谎丹，只要你说谎，吞服这枚测谎丹后，你的元神就会爆开，你敢吞服吗？”
“为了证明我的清白，我敢！”
从火魅手里拿走丹药，直接放入嘴里咽了下去。
等着，林铮当然知道火魅拿出的所谓测谎丹根本就是假的，虽然他不是炼丹师，但也清楚这个世界上，恐怕还没有这样的丹药。
完全是火魅故意诈自己。
“火魅长老，我的元神并未爆裂，看来我并未说谎，现在你终该信我了吧。”
嘴角上挑，火魅很明显还没有全信。
火魅站起身走到洞口停了下来，突然问道：“你和洛清漪有婚约？”
“你恐怕没有机会娶她。”
不等林铮多问，火魅起身离开洞府。
站在洞府内，林铮当然明白火魅的意思。
随着清漪觉醒皇品血脉，被湮鼎宗宗主收为关门弟子，清漪在湮鼎宗日后的地位会越来越高，甚至不排除接管湮鼎宗。
双拳慢慢握住，林铮的眼神逐渐变的坚定起来。
“我会告诉所有人，我配得上清漪。”
“小子，想要娶人家，就要努力让自己变的强大起来。”
“我会的。”
没有继续纠结此事，林铮盘膝坐在石蒲上，开始静静地修炼起来。
夜幕降临。
几声蛐蛐叫在寂静的夜晚显得很是刺耳。
咦？
林铮猛然睁开双眼，说道：“塔爷，我气海内的一枚龙蛋要孵化了。”
“那是好事。”
气海内。
一枚白色龙蛋出现蛋壳碎裂声，一道道裂痕开始遍布龙蛋各处，随着裂痕越来越多，不一会，一条拳头大小的白色小龙孵化而出，整个身体好像个馒头，挺着肚子。
林铮尝试调动气海的力量，看看是否能够将小龙召唤出来。
“真胖。”
真的顺利召唤出，但林铮却是皱着眉头，看着石桌上蹦蹦跳跳的白色小龙，简直太丑了。
“好像孕妇一样。”
“吱吱。”
“叫声怎么像老鼠。”
“吱吱。”
content_en:
Huo Mei smiled.
The smile was weird, and Lin Zheng looked a little creepy.
"Elder Huo Mei, you might as well tell him if you have something to say."
"You still don't want to become a disciple?"
"My talent is limited. Elder Huo Mei might as well go see other people. I like to practice alone."
"Hmph!"
With a slight snort, Huo Mei asked coldly: "Let me ask you now, were you really helping me swallow poison before?"
"Yes."
Huo Mei stretched out her hand, holding a pill in her hand, and said: "Lie Detection Pill, as long as you lie, after swallowing this lie detection pill, your soul will explode. Do you dare to swallow it?"
"To prove my innocence, I dare!"
He took the elixir from Huo Mei's hand, put it directly into his mouth and swallowed it.
Waiting, of course Lin Zheng knew that the so-called lie detector pill Huo Mei took out was completely fake. Although he was not an alchemist, he also knew that there might not be such a pill in the world.
It was completely Huo Mei who deliberately deceived herself.
"Elder Huo Mei, my soul has not exploded. It seems that I did not lie. Now you should finally believe me."
The corners of her mouth raised, Huo Mei obviously didn't believe it all.
Huo Mei stood up and walked to the entrance of the cave, stopped, and suddenly asked: "Are you engaged to Luo Qingyi?"
"Yes."
"I'm afraid you have no chance of marrying her."
Before Lin Zheng could ask any more questions, Huo Mei stood up and left the cave.
Standing in the cave, Lin Zheng certainly understood what Huo Mei meant.
As Qingyi awakens the imperial bloodline and is accepted as a closed disciple by the master of the Diding Sect, Qingyi's status in the Diding Sect will become higher and higher in the future, and he will not even rule out taking over the Diding Sect.
Slowly clenching his fists, Lin Zheng's eyes gradually became firm.
"I will tell everyone that I am worthy of Qingyi."
"Boy, if you want to marry someone, you have to work hard to become stronger."
"I will."
Without continuing to dwell on the matter, Lin Zheng sat cross-legged on the stone cattails and began to practice quietly.
Night falls.
A few crickets chirped very harshly in the silent night.
Huh?
Lin Zheng suddenly opened his eyes and said, "Master Ta, a dragon egg in my Qi Sea is about to hatch."
"That's a good thing."
Within the air sea.
A white dragon egg made a cracking sound, and cracks began to spread all over the egg. As the cracks became more and more, after a while, a small white dragon the size of a fist hatched out. The whole body was like a steamed bun, with a bulging belly.
Lin Zheng tried to mobilize the power of Qihai to see if he could summon the little dragon.
"So fat."
It was really summoned successfully, but Lin Zheng frowned and looked at the white dragon jumping on the stone table. It was so ugly.
"Like a pregnant woman."
"Zhizhi."
"Why does it sound like a mouse?"
"Zhizhi."
